statement: let T := fun (m : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, Real.cos (2*Real.pi*(2:ℝ)^(j+1)*t); ∀ (m : ℕ) (s : ℝ), intervalIntegral (fun t => Real.exp (s*T m t)) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume ≤ (Real.cosh s)^m
